image_description: A mature male orangutan with long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and prominent cheek pads is lying on a grassy surface. The view is partially obstructed by out-of-focus wire fencing in the foreground. The orangutan's face is visible, showing dark eyes and a broad nose. Its body appears barrel-chested, and one arm is visible resting on the ground.
